name: clearly
description: Clearly — your company brain + spatial canvas over MCP, for Claude Code and any MCP agent.

plugins.name: clearly
plugins.description: Connect your Clearly workspace as a company brain + spatial canvas: search org context (prompts, docs, decisions, facts), write decisions back so they compound, and drive an infinite Skia canvas — land diffs, diagrams, and codebase maps as real vector nodes the human annotates back. Use the canvas as mission control for a coding task (pair-on-canvas): pin a spec, do the repo work, report diffs + status as cards. Bundles the pre-configured MCP server plus skills: clearly-init, clearly-workflows, clearly-canvas, pair-on-canvas, ship-review, visualize, codebase-map, sticker-pack.
